title: The hybrid cache
brief: Store KV entries for full-attention layers and recurrent state for the rest, then measure the speedup.
hints: Preallocate at max_seq_len and write into a slice. Concatenating copies the cache every step.
Advance the write cursor once per forward pass, after every layer has run — not inside each layer.
Only full-attention layers grow. Linear-attention layers overwrite a fixed state.
